rationale.conceptual: The paper proposes a custom homogenization scheme combining self-consistent and Mori-Tanaka methods with novel interaction equations, requiring deep understanding of elastoviscoplastic crystal plasticity, affine linearization, Eshelby problems, and iterative solvers. Multiple interacting mathematical components must be carefully translated into code.
rationale.execution: The pipeline is essentially a single simulation run with sequential steps (material definition, homogenization implementation, two simulations) producing four CSV files. No external tooling, data fetching, or multi-script orchestration; straightforward I/O with standard libraries.

Resource needs are minimal: 500-grain polycrystal, CPU-only, tiny memory, no dataset.
